If you have skillets with accumulated and heavy grease build up this works great. I've resurrected many flea-market & yard sale skillets this way and it is the simplest & least messy way to de-crud them. Get a container big enough so that a skillet will lay upside down on the bottom and do this all outside. I use a large tote with lid. Fill container so there is at last 3 " of warm water over the skillet when you put it in. Then get 1 lb. of pure lye drain cleaner at the hardware store and wearing eye protection, slowly pour the crystals in without splashing. When all the lye has dissolved (you may need to to stir it), immerse the skillet into the contariner for 24 hours. Make sure there are no air pockets under the skillet. This usually works the first time and if not, continue to soak until it does. Thoroughly rinse when clean, then reseason cast-iron as needed.
